name: medicine ball backward overhead toss
description: A backward throw of a medicine ball over the head from a squat. It builds hip and back power.
instructions: Stand holding a medicine ball in front of your thighs.
Squat down and swing the ball between your legs.
Drive up and extend your hips.
Throw the ball up and backward over your head.
Keep your arms long and make sure the space behind you is clear.
